verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Commander Legends card handlers and helpers. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Preserve native quirks, repeated queries, context reads and opaque dialogs.
review_notes: Sixty alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local renames; 26 structured definitions receive source review and one target build.
Repeated searches preserve live active-card bounds, attachment/source matching, duplicate suppression and all work after finding an existing legacy.

Death helpers retain different eligibility/count queries, source-death early returns, detach byte flags, count masking, pending-record clearing, token quantities and cleanup kills. Colfenor retains main/effect record slot differences, int16 snapshots, unmeld/grave query order, persistent selection filters, repeated ID queries, retry budgets and per-row duplicate decrements.
Keep equipment/granted-ability routes, protection snapshots and repeated queries, mode rereads following validation, target filters, fizzle results and cost differences.

Keep Kamahl cached land count/damage mode through animation callbacks, live final damage-target count, native index clamping and reverse creature damage; preserve War Room extra-life-loss and AI branches.

Alpha-only changes preserve native quirks in Rootweaver marked/selected indices, Blim transfer behavior, creature-counter scans, Hans queries and return values, commander/player slots, Jeska and monarch queries. Opaque dialogs remain unchanged; no new native semantic cases or historical replay.
status: Applied readability batch. One target build and coverage receipt follow; reccmp refresh is deferred to a larger checkpoint.
